name: e-Mobility Systems Laboratory
description: This lab focuses on experimental analysis and control of electric drive and power electronic systems used in e-mobility applications. Students will study slip variation and V/f control in induction motors, back-EMF characteristics and speed control of PMSM and BLDC motors, and modulation techniques for three-phase inverters including SPWM and SVPWM. The lab also covers DC–DC converter control with emphasis on constant current and constant voltage operation.
